You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0174.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
s='O[C:101]1[CH2:102][C:103]([CH2:104][CH2:105][C:106](=O)[NH:107][CH2:108][CH2:109][C:110]2=[CH:111][CH:112][N+:113](=[C:114]([NH2:115])[NH2:116])[CH2:117]2)[C:118]([NH:119][C:120](=O)[C:121]([NH:122][C:123](=O)[C:124]([O:125][CH3:126])[CH2:127][O:128][S:129](=O)(=O)[O-:130])[C:131]([Cl:132])([CH:133]([CH3:134])[CH3:135]))[CH2:136][C:137]1O'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
if m is None: raise Exception('parse failed')
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
# coords in screen coordinates; converted y to upward
xy={101:(212,164),102:(315,102),103:(420,164),104:(534,126),105:(604,222),106:(720,222),107:(755,320),108:(902,326),109:(963,429),110:(1080,429),111:(1152,334),112:(1267,368),113:(1267,493),114:(1363,536),115:(1450,505),116:(1350,620),117:(1152,524),118:(420,282),119:(536,324),120:(570,425),121:(510,536),122:(550,648),123:(510,738),124:(570,847),125:(528,915),126:(480,978),127:(692,847),128:(728,790),129:(780,740),130:(850,730),131:(383,536),132:(350,473),133:(342,614),134:(270,650),135:(405,680),136:(315,344),137:(212,282),138:(155,326)}
mapidx={a.GetAtomMapNum():a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetAtomMapNum()}
stereo={137:(138,'dash'),103:(None,'dash'),118:(None,'dash'),121:(122,'dash'),124:(125,'solid')}
# rank priorities by CIPRank (high first), construct rough vectors per drawing
for mp,(wedgemap,kind) in stereo.items():
    i=mapidx[mp]; a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i); center=np.array([xy[mp][0],-xy[mp][1],0.],float)
    neigh=[]
    for nb in a.GetNeighbors():
        ni=nb.GetIdx()
        if nb.GetAtomicNum()==1:
            # H receives opposite depth from specified wedged bond
            z=1 if kind=='dash' else -1
            v=np.array([0.,0.,z])
        else:
            nmap=nb.GetAtomMapNum()
            x,y=xy[nmap]
            z=0
            if nmap==wedgemap: z=-1 if kind=='dash' else 1
            v=np.array([x-center[0],-y-center[1],z],float)
        rank=nb.GetProp('_CIPRank') if nb.HasProp('_CIPRank') else 'NA'
        neigh.append((int(rank) if rank!='NA' else -1,ni,nb.GetSymbol(),nb.GetAtomMapNum(),v))
    neigh.sort(reverse=True,key=lambda x:x[0])
    vs=[x[4] for x in neigh]
    det=np.linalg.det(np.array([vs[0]-vs[3],vs[1]-vs[3],vs[2]-vs[3]]))
    target='R' if det<0 else 'S'
    print('center',mp, 'neighbors rank/map/sym',[(x[0],x[3],x[2]) for x in neigh], 'det',det,'target',target)
    a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CW)
    Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
    cip=a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?'
    if cip != target:
        a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_TETRAHEDRAL_CCW)
        Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
        cip=a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?'
    print('assigned',cip)

print(Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
# generate 3D
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=174; params.useSmallRingTorsions=True
ret=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed',ret, 'atoms',m.GetNumAtoms())
if ret<0: raise Exception('embed failed')
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
if props:
  ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props); ff.Minimize(maxIts=1000)
else: print('No MMFF')
# verify coordinates generated center chirality CIP unaffected
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nMolecule generated from mol_0174.png\n')
    for at in m.GetAtoms():
        p=conf.GetAtomPosition(at.GetIdx())
        f.write(f'{at.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
print('final stereos',[(mp,m.GetAtomWithIdx(mapidx[mp]).GetProp('_CIPCode')) for mp in stereo])

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
# atom indices set
symbols=['C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','O','O','O','C','C','C','H','H']
# indices 17 H on uppermiddle dashed; 18 H at pent lower-left opposite OH
rw=Chem.RWMol()
for s in symbols:
 a=Chem.Atom(s)
 if s=='H': a.SetNoImplicit(True)
 rw.AddAtom(a)
bonds=[(0,1,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(0,2,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(2,3,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(3,4,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(4,1,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(1,5,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(5,6,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(6,7,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(7,10,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(10,9,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(9,8,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(8,7,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(8,0,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(0,11,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(4,12,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(7,13,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(1,14,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(10,15,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(10,16,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(8,17,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(4,18,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)]
for i,j,b in bonds: rw.AddBond(i,j,b)
m=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
# image coords (flip y) plus z: solid wedge toward positive z
coords={0:(259,-235,0),1:(259,-355,0),2:(145,-197,0),3:(74,-294,0),4:(145,-391,0),5:(363,-415,0),6:(467,-355,0),7:(467,-235,0),8:(363,-175,0),9:(422,-68,0),10:(527,-132,0),11:(259,-113,1),12:(111,-423,-1),13:(545,-252,1),14:(259,-424,1),15:(585,-150,0),16:(561,-78,0),17:(335,-145,-1),18:(160,-418,1)}
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
conf.Set3D(True)
for i,(x,y,z) in coords.items(): conf.SetAtomPosition(i, Point3D(x/100,y/100,z))
m.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m, confId=0, replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
print('stereo centers')
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'): print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode'),a.GetChiralTag())
# remove sketch coordinates and add any implicit H, retaining explicit drawn H
m.RemoveAllConformers()
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=182; params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True; params.maxIterations=1000
status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed status', status, 'atoms',m.GetNumAtoms())
if status<0:
 raise RuntimeError('embedding failed')
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
if props:
 print('MMFF',AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m, maxIters=1000))
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'): print('final',a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode'),a.GetChiralTag())
# write xyz
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\n3D structure generated from mol_0182.png\n')
 conf=m.GetConformer()
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
  f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
print('written answer.xyz')
